sarah: Heads-up — console "effective roles" preview is out of sync with auth-service for scoped tokens. Repro: create role `ingest-runner` scoped to dataset:billing, add per-route override for /v1/ingest -> console preview shows NO access but auth-service grants a token. Anyone seen this?
kevin: Ugh. Haven't seen that exact combo. Is this tenant-specific or reproducible on staging?
li: I can repro on staging. Quick check shows console calls `/api/preview/effective` which returns cached snapshot_ts older than the token check.
anita: That sounds like the snapshot reconciliation job didn't run. We had leader-election flaps earlier today. Could be a race where console reads pre-reconcile snapshot while auth-service reads live policy graph.
sarah: Minimal repro curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer user-x" https://staging.auth.redwood/api/v1/check?route=/v1/ingest&scope=dataset:billing
```
console preview request: 
```
POST /api/preview/effective {"principal":"svc:ingest", "route":"/v1/ingest"}
-> {"access": false, "snapshot_ts": "2025-11-12T09:12:03Z"}
```
auth check returns `{ "allowed": true, "policy_revision": "rev-20251112-0915" }`
kevin: So auth is newer. We should expose `snapshot_ts` on the preview UI and surface a tiny warning when snapshot is > 30s old. Quick fix.
li: Agree. Also we need to track why reconciliation lagged. `reconcile-leader` logs show leader re-election at 09:13 and reconcile restarted at 09:16 — gap matches.
anita: Long-term: console preview should optionally request `force_reconcile=true` for an on-demand preflight (with rate limits). But we must be careful — reconcile is heavy for large tenants. Maybe add lightweight delta-check: a fast API that compares `policy_revision` from auth-service vs snapshot header.
kevin: Proposal: add `x-policy-revision` header to preview responses and show a small orange pill if `x-policy-revision != auth.policy_revision`. Sample header: `X-Policy-Revision: rev-20251112-0915`.
li: Implementation note: console currently reads `/store/snapshots/latest` which is eventually consistent via s3+index. We can add a cached `revision_index` in redis updated by reconcile leader. That yields O(1) compare instead of full reconcile.
perm-bot: Permission cache invalidated for tenant:acme-corp at 1758943302 (auto).
sarah: Nice. For UX: show `Last reconciled 3m ago` with a tooltip and a small CTA `Refresh preview` that calls preview with `force_delta_check=true`.
anita: I'll sketch the backend change: new lightweight endpoint `/api/preview/compare` that returns `{ "snapshot_revision": "rev-..", "auth_revision": "rev-..", "consistent": false }`. Console calls it first and only falls back to heavy `force_reconcile` when user clicks refresh.
kevin: Sounds good. Can we ship a quick guard this week? If we add header + UI pill it's low-risk. I'll make a small PR to add `X-Policy-Revision` to preview responses and the `Last reconciled` field in console.
li: I'll add a smoke test that creates a role, toggles route override, and asserts the preview header matches auth check after reconcile.
sarah: Assigning follow-ups: kevin -> header+UI pill PR, li -> smoke test + monitor alert if snapshot delta > 120s, anita -> design `compare` endpoint spec. I'll open tasks and link here. :thumbsup:
kevin: On it.
li: Will add monitoring today.
anita: Writing endpoint spec now.
perm-bot: Note: reconcile job restarted automatically at 1758943340.
sarah: Thanks all. We'll disable `force_reconcile` in UI for now; use delta compare first. Keep me posted.
